mentions.name: Bubble Mix
mentions.description: A casual browser game revived from a 15-year-old project and polished with AI; it looks simple but is fairly well balanced and offers a quick endorphin fix.
mentions.audience: Casual players seeking a quick endorphin fix
mentions.source_excerpt:
I dusted off my 15-year-old game and polished it a bit with AI - https://zabiyaka.com/games/bubblemix/

Despite looking simple, it's fairly well balanced and a quick endorphin fix :)
mentions.author: afidrya
